title: add-benchmark-lab-reporting-pipeline-v59-and-representative-runners
author: Jared Patel
description: Motivation: The benchmark lab needs a more robust reporting pipeline to aggregate representative workload results and profiling baselines across multi-variant experiments. This PR introduces the v59 reporting pipeline: a Kubernetes job + lightweight ETL that normalizes runner outputs, computes baseline/variant comparisons, and pushes artifacts to the benchmark dashboard storage. Summary of changes: added representative workload runner harness (python), updated profiling baselines collector, new reporting pipeline k8s manifest and Helm values, small SDK helpers for result serialization, and documentation. This PR also wires CI to run a smoke end-to-end on a small sample workload. What changed: - benchmark-lab/runners/representative_runner.py: new runner harness that executes representative workloads with deterministic seeding and KV-cache warmup steps. - benchmark-lab/profiling/collector.py: baseline aggregation logic and new metrics schema. - benchmark-lab/jobs/reporting_pipeline.yaml: k8s batch job manifest for v59, with configurable parallelism and GCS/MinIO sinks. - scripts/generate_report.py: ETL that merges runner outputs, computes delta vs baseline, and uploads artifacts. - redwood-helm-charts/benchmark-lab/values-v59.yaml: deployment values for the reporting job and RBAC. - docs/benchmark-lab/README.md: updated guidance for running reporting pipeline locally and on CI. - tests/benchmark_lab/test_integration_reporting.py: added a smoke integration test (fast, uses sample data). Testing and verification: - Local unit tests for serialization/metrics (green). - CI: initial run failed due to flaky metric timestamp formatting; fixed in commit 3 and re-ran. - Integration smoke test added to CI; passes on re-run. Rollout plan: deploy Helm chart to staging namespace, run full representative workload sweep overnight, validate reporting artifacts in staging dashboard, then promote to prod and schedule a follow-up to monitor costs. Checklist: [x] unit tests [x] integration smoke test [x] docs updated [x] Helm values added [x] reviewers approved
